rules.material: affected value > value_threshold_usd OR affected value / counted treasury value > treasury_share_threshold
rules.critical_core_input: a treasury-controlled address, token, contract, oracle or position representing >= critical_core_share_threshold of counted treasury value, or any required input whose absence makes the score non-reproducible or mathematically incomplete
rules.undetermined: the affected value cannot be calculated because the failed check prevents valuation; never assumed immaterial
rules.material_effect: provisional; affected value excluded or reclassified per class; confidence = min(confidence, confidence_cap)
rules.conflicts: all candidate values are preserved; never resolved automatically, never the most favourable value

contract_identity_control.non_material: retain the score, disclose the limitation
contract_identity_control.material: provisional; the affected position is excluded from verified value; confidence capped

realizability_control.rule: stays in gross value, excluded from liquid value; material share: provisional; affects a core solvency or runway input: insufficient_data

naming_control.rule: non-material when the address is independently attributed (registry, Safe configuration, governance record, transaction history); material when the name is the only link: exclude the wallet from verified value or provisional; critical: insufficient_data

price_comparison.rule: <= 2%: passes; > 2% and <= 5%: attestation flag only; > 5% on a material position: material price conflict, provisional; no defensible price: materiality by affected position, critical: insufficient_data, otherwise provisional with the value excluded or conservatively valued

retrieval_control.rule: a transport failure while another source agrees: disclosed, no score change; chain state unretrievable for a material position: material; critical: insufficient_data

disclosure_reconciliation.rule: reconciliation flag; unresolved difference above the thresholds: provisional; the observed value is never rewritten to match the report

obligation_visibility.rule: existing obligations policy: a one-time obligations_penalty_points deduction when materially incomplete; insufficient_data when missing obligations make the score non-reproducible
obligation_visibility.deferred_until: Build C (owner 2026-10-17, D20): until the missing obligations can be valued, the existing rule stays live: PARTIAL_OBLIGATIONS_PENALTY (10 points, once per report) whenever obligations are partial and bounded, regardless of materiality
